name: popups-thank-you-bar-v1
title: Thank-you Bar v1
description: Thank-you V2: a white pill that slides down from the top edge of the page, over the navigation — check mark, bold title, grey body and a × button. Hides itself after 6 s (pauses while hovered or focused), announces itself as a status message, instant under reduced motion. Pair it with the Sign-up Popup: close the popup on Join and show the bar.
